sources.finding: Official project-status table lists Eckart second-floor renovation with 1,900 new and 12,200 renovated assignable square feet. Retrieved table is construction timing and budget, not numbered room geometry.
Official room guide identifies 225 as Computer Lab Classroom, 227 as Lecture Hall and 236 as Classroom. It supplies reservation links but no room boundary drawing.
Current student-space page corroborates room names. Existing review already established the image is a calendar color key, not a plan; not counted as a new diagram.

limitations: Previously inspected obr photographs and Mosher Drew axonometric/site illustration are not re-counted as plans.
Renovations in 2012–2017 and 2022/2023 prevent treating an old library plan as a current numbered classroom layout.
